isatvon_definition.i_instructions: Registered in system_skills_registry (skill_index 9) but with is_active=false, and NOT present in Standard_BOM_Flow's live routing_sequence -- this tool is fully implemented but not currently exercised by the live product. Action (as implemented): validate rfq_id, look up a registered ERP file (file_role='ERP'); since upload_server.py's ERP upload endpoint has been repurposed for Costing Sheet, no ERP file is ever registered in the current product, so this tool always returns status:'skipped' today. If it were ever called with a real ERP file registered, it would run process_erp() and append standardized rows to a standing (not RFQ-scoped) erp reference table. Check: rfq_id format guard; write result status=='success' on the hypothetical non-skipped path. Bound: single attempt, no retry loop. Business rule: the erp table is a standing reference table shared across RFQs, not scoped to one rfq_id -- rows are appended, not gated by an rfq_id existence check.
